Hybrid permanent direct-NZ indexes live in wordIndexBuf; naturalBuf is only init scratch, unpack work and existing alpha Brcb work. No persistent indexes are stored in naturalBuf.
Current Softmax already overwrites naturalBuf for alpha after reduction. The proposed earlier512B finite result use is within the same dead lifetime.
PrefetchValues occurs after complete Softmax/PReady and rebuilds natural unpack data from the retained packed buffers. PipelineUnpack/Publish barriers protect prior alpha/finite use.
Pending future errors remain separately saved. CommitPrefetchErrors stays after current PV consumption; batching current finite reads must not move that boundary.
